forest_seed.description: places the forests and their plants, so it picks the walk too

patch_size.description: metres : size of the forests and of the open land between them

coverage.description: part of the gentle land under forest

max_slope.description: degrees : slope of the land no forest grows on

herds.description: kinds of herds and their animals (docs/animals.md)

herd_cell.description: metres : one herd at most per cell of this size

herd_density.description: part of the cells that have a herd

herd_range.description: metres : how far from its home a herd goes (they stay by the walk)

herd_radius.description: metres : herds this close to the camera exist

distance.description: metres walked : open land, a forest, open land

lead.description: metres of open land before the forest and after it

soil.description: how much the walk is picked for the mud, the stones and the sand it crosses; 0 : not looked at

watch.description: metres : the camera turns to the herds this close; 0 : not looked at

exit.description: the process ends with the walk (a profile of it : tools/profile_run.py)
